description: Fair draws (a pack of cards, a loot box, a daily prize; declared with neblla_update_app({ draws }), opened by the user with neblla.db.draw(name)). Action "info" { draw }: the chance of each card, the cost and the free openings. Action "opens" { user? (their id in the app), draw?, limit? (up to 500, 50 by default) } → { opens }: the log of openings, newest first, each with owner, draw, at, paid ({ free } or { credits, n }) and the cards dealt (rows, with their id). To give a user packs, adjust their credits (neblla_credits).

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

name: neblla_draws
title: Draws
